This petition has been filed seeking quashing of FIR No.237/2022 PS Sagarpur under Sections 498A/406/34 IPC basis of settlement dated 11th, August, 2023 arrived at with the facilitation of the Mediation Centre, Dwarka Courts, New Delhi, which is on record of this Court.

entities.text: Mediation Centre, Dwarka Courts, New Delhi
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: 2. As per the settlement, out of total settlement amount of Rs.6 Lacs, the outstanding balance of Rs.2 Lacs is tendered vide DD No.241356 drawn on State Bank of India and duly received by respondent No.2 in Court.
3. Petitioner Nos.1 & 2 and respondent No.2/complainant are present in Court, petitioner Nos.3 and 4 are present through VC.
All parties are duly identified by the IO and their respective counsels.

4. The marriage of the petitioner No.1 and respondent No.2 was solemnised on 29th November,
2017, but due to marital discord, the marriage This is a digitally signed order.
The authenticity of the order can be re-verified from Delhi High Court Order Portal by scanning the QR code shown above.
The Order is downloaded from the DHC Server on 15/08/2024 at 04:03:10 has resulted in a divorce by decree dated 05th January, 2024.
No child was born out of wedlock.

5. Considering the above settlement between the parties and the chances of conviction of the petitioners being remote and bleak, there is no use continuing with proceedings of the present FIR as it would be a misuse of the process of the Court and an unnecessary burden on the State exchequer.
Accordingly, the petition is allowed.
Consequently, the FIR No.237/2022 PS Sagarpur under Sections 498A/406/34 IPC and proceedings emanating therefrom are quashed.
6. Parties shall abide by the terms of settlement.
